paragraphs: This is placeholder copy in a sample edition. On a real morning this paragraph says what happened and why it happened now, in about forty words, written so that a reader who has never followed the story can still follow this one.
The second paragraph carries the context a newcomer needs: the number that has been climbing for years, the decision nobody made, the two things that cannot both stay true.
The third paragraph says what is still unresolved — the part nobody can answer yet, which is usually the part worth remembering.
stories.changes: In a real edition this line says what the story changes for an ordinary reader.
stories.unchanged: And this line punctures the overreaction: what it does not change.
